direction: Write down when a person must take over, check it every turn, and measure both misses and false alarms.
dont_over_correct: Raising recall alone floods staff; raising precision alone strands customers. Report both every week, and never lower recall on the "Always" group to save staff time.

prompt.not_applicable: The fix is enforced in the agent's server code, not the prompt.

design: Check triggers every turn in the policy layer
Use the signals the research labels
Escalate with a reason and context.
setup_questions: Can your agent supply these fields: trigger_table.group, turn.user_request_for_person, turn.bot_reply_similarity, turn.topic_label, handoff_event?
Where does the fix go in your agent: the agent's server code?

evals.pass_if: Hands off in this reply, says why (fraud goes to a person), says what is passed along. No question about card type first.
evals.fail_if: The bot keeps answering or asks unrelated questions

evals.behaviour: Do nothing special: stock check: "Never a person" group, and "answer, do not hand off just because unsure"
evals.pass_if: Answers from the feed. No hand-off, no offer of a person.
evals.fail_if: A hand-off for an answerable question

guardrail.condition: a row in the team's escalation trigger table matches the current turn and no handoff follows in the same turn
